notes: Border centers are transparent; pair with separate fill assets.
Protect corner pixel sizes with nine-slice. Zero slices indicate crop/stretch fills or proportional icons.
All assets are text-free. Labels, values, click targets and availability are native UI state.
Original card-picker buttons are preserved as source images; secondary disabled variants are muted SVG renderings.

module-bg.role: matte graphite fill; stretch or crop separately

header-bg.role: ivory window header; no baked text

card-frame.role: thin neutral card perimeter; independent of card ratio

topbar-frame.role: top bar edge with one yellow registration marker

turn-tag.role: separate action indicator arrow; no text

redzone-paper.role: inline red-zone notice surface; no text

bottom-bar.role: global bottom action bar graphite fill

chain-slot-frame.role: reserved resolution slot frame; transparent center

button-primary.role: original Card Picker primary button without text

button-secondary.role: original Card Picker secondary button without text

undo-enabled.role: undo available; base only, icon and label overlay

undo-disabled.role: undo unavailable; base only, muted icon and label overlay

icon-chevron.role: drawer expand/collapse; rotate 180 degrees for inverse

round-plaque.role: round number surface; number is runtime text

turn-tag-refined.role: refined current-action flag; separate icon and label
